mapper.select: SELECT * FROM resume WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND resume_status = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO resume ( resume_name, user_id, real_name, gender, phone, email, photo, job_intention, certificates, campus_experience, work_experience, project_experience, self_evaluation, ai_score, ai_evaluation, resume_status, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{resumeName}, #{userId}, #{realName}, #{gender}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{photo}, #{jobIntention}, #{certificates}, #{campusExperience}, #{workExperience}, #{projectExperience}, #{selfEvaluation}, #{aiScore}, #{aiEvaluation}, #{resumeStatus}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.update: UPDATE resume SET resume_name = #{resumeName}, user_id = #{userId}, real_name = #{realName}, gender = #{gender}, phone = #{phone}, email = #{email}, photo = #{photo}, job_intention = #{jobIntention}, certificates = #{certificates}, campus_experience = #{campusExperience}, work_experience = #{workExperience}, project_experience = #{projectExperience}, self_evaluation = #{selfEvaluation}, ai_score = #{aiScore}, ai_evaluation = #{aiEvaluation}, resume_status = #{resumeStatus}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE resume_id = #{resumeId}
